Name: Gossip Girl TV
Author: joejames38
Description:
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install the required framework mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24278
[*]Download this mod Directly or via the Vortex Mod manager 
[*]Ensure it is unzipped and in the Mods Folder
[/list]
[b]More information[/b]
A little mod that adds a new regular TV show. It's magic rewards those interested in Gossip.

Check the TV every day and let the magic of gossip reward you!

The magic of the Gossip gives the curious farmer a little item relevant to the gossip that they just saw. It may be mentioned directly in the gossip or a loved gift of one of those being discussed. Tune in Daily!

[b]Disclaimer[/b]
Although the mod gives the player items, there aren't really game breaking items delivered. Maybe some community center items, but it is mostly loved gifts that come through the air waves. 

[b]Trivia
[/b]TV image inspired by the famous Harry Potter Gossip Girl, Rita Skeeter. 


[b]Future Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Always adding more Gossip from all kinds of places
[*]Looking to expand gossip for other major mods in Stardew Valley 
[*]Maybe one day, the nosey little Gossip Girl may come to the valley and do some local snooping. 
[/list]
[b]Expansions Notes[/b]
Currently, I have added support for translations, but I want to get the mod a little more mature before I accept merge requests for adding in translations.

Monday - Mount Vapius (Not Implemented, yet)
Tuesday - Passerby Cemetary (Not Implemented, yet)
Wednesday - Zuzu City (Not implemented, yet)
Thursday - Stardew Valley Expanded (Not Implemented, yet)
Friday - Vanilla Game Gossip (100 pieces of unique gossip)
Saturday - Easy Scarp (Implemented with 70 pieces of gossip)
Sunday - Ridgeside Village (Not implemented, yet)

PS. I love Expansion Mods and run them all concurrently. 

[b]Mod Limitations - turning on/off Days of gossip[/b]
The framework mod has some bugs and limitations, and if they are fixed, I hope I can make the appropriate updates. 

One limitation is that it accepts a single file for a TV channel, so I have to put all gossip in one file. 

Another limitation, is that I can't leverage a config file through content patcher into the framework mod, so it requires file manipulation to turn on and off expansion channels.  I will look into alternative solutions in the future.
To turn on more gossip for now, just change "False" to the day you want to see that gossip.  Ex "Sat"
